(e) Exception to annual privacy notice requirement —(1) When exception available. You are not required to deliver an annual privacy notice if you:
(i) Provide nonpublic personal information to nonaffiliated third parties only in accordance with an exception; and
(ii) Have not changed your policies and practices with regard to disclosing nonpublic personal information.
(2) Exception no longer available. If you no longer meet the requirements of paragraph (e)(1) of this section:
(i) If a revised privacy notice was required, you must provide an annual privacy notice.
(ii) If a revised privacy notice was not required, you must provide an annual privacy notice within 100 days.
